subject: Air freight quote request to LAX
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the same shipment as in my earlier request, "Air freight quote request: STR to MEL", sent on 2026-11-21 at 23:18 UTC for destination MEL? The cargo and pickup details are unchanged, and you already have them from that request.

The new destination is LAX, and the shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-29. Please send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest option.

Thank you.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer requests an all-in price for a new destination and pickup date, which is a new quote request.
